title: Paper collage
summary: A 40-45 s narrated explainer, 16:9 and 9:16 from one project, in the Vox-style paper-collage look: a true story one sentence per scene, real photos cut out as white-border stickers, torn paper, clippings, stamps and typed labels landing on their words, over halftone b-roll, with captions and a sources end card.

from_story: a true story that fits in eight sentences, with a source for every fact
2-3 licensed photos of the people in it (Wikimedia Commons first)
logos, a chart or a document if the story has them
one number or turn worth stamping
generated: one b-roll shot per b-roll scene, no people (tools/footage.md)

fits: news explainers: an IPO, a collapse, a verdict, a deal
short biographies of founders and public figures
company histories and 'how did we get here' stories
feed posts that need 16:9 and 9:16 and play muted
avoid: stories without licensed photos of the people in them
rumours or anything a source cannot back
stories that need more than about 60 s

title: B-roll wheel launch
summary: A 90 s keynote-style launch: real-world b-roll under kinetic type, a 'Your [ ]' wheel between chapters, the product's real screens floating over footage, a beat montage at 35 %, One More Thing, dot-to-logo end.

from_product: brand palette (9 roles) and two fonts
one wide illustration or hero image
two crops of real site/app cards with their key rows
generated: one 90 s 120 BPM music track (prompt in project/tools/music.md)
footage: 9 b-roll clips: stock or generated (slots in project/tools/broll-prompts.md)

fits: software with a real UI and a clear before/after
brands with an illustration or mascot
launches that need warmth as well as product
avoid: products with no screens to show
under 30 s (use a cut-down: open, one chapter, montage, end)

title: Feature roster
summary: A 25-30 s launch film for social feeds, 16:9 and 9:16 from one project: a hook in the product's own words, the product's agents or features as a roster that flies up into a tab bar, one 3 s beat per member with a push into the real screenshot and a colour ring on the proof, then the team gathers on the logo.

from_product: 1-3 real screenshots that show every member's work
a small icon or avatar per member (cut from the screenshots)
the product's own copy: a two-line problem, a one-line promise, a tagline, one status line per member
generated: one 120 BPM music track, film length (prompt in project/tools/music.md)

fits: AI agents or assistants with named roles
products with 3-6 distinct features, modules or plans that each have a screen
feed posts and launch threads that need 16:9 and 9:16
avoid: products with no screens to show
one-feature products (use a single-feature film instead)
more than 6 members (the tab bar and the length stop working)
